features: Recognised as the "Best Smart Ring" at the Amazon Best In Tech Awards (BITA) 2025, the Gabit Smart Ring is rated 8/10 by 91mobiles and is trusted by top influencers such as Rajiv Makhni, Raj Shamani, and Shivoham (celebrity fitness trainer), making waves across both tech and fitness circles.

GABIT SMART RING is the world’s first smart ring that tracks all 4 pillars of health – Sleep, Fitness, Nutrition, and Stress with no subscription fee and a powerful 7+ day battery life, is built with titanium for durability, is feather-light and water-resistant up to 50m. Gabit is the only wearable to track Calorie surplus/deficit, along with 30+ workout modes, Automatic Workout Detection, and women’s health features including period tracking. It also includes powerful AI features like PEP – your AI Health Coach, Voice-based Food Logging, and personalized health insights. Get real-time tracking of your key body markers – VO2 Max, Resting Heart Rate, Heart Rate Variability (HRV), Heart Rate.
BUY THE SIZING KIT FIRST: Gabit Smart Ring sizes differ from standard ring sizes. Buy the Gabit Ring Sizing Kit to find your perfect fit. For queries, contact us via the details on the Gabit website.

SLEEK, STRONG & LONG-LASTING: Built to suit your lifestyle, the Gabit Smart Ring can go 7+ day on a single charge. Crafted from lightweight titanium, weighing just 3.1g, and water-resistant up to 50m, it’s built for nonstop wear - whether you're working, travelling, or working out.

ACTIVITY TRACKING, MADE SIMPLE: Track your daily activity with 30+ workout modes or let the ring auto-detect movement. Monitor heart rate zone, steps, pace, distance, and intensity in real time - plus get on-demand VO2 Max to assess your body’s oxygen efficiency. With Active Score and workout insights to measure your progress effortlessly. For deeper support, work with a coach to get personalized fitness and nutrition plans. Gabit is built for long-term health — helping you live healthier and longer.

DESIGNED FOR WEIGHT LOSS: Simply speak to log meals, build good nutrition habits, and stay in a healthy calorie deficit. Gabit gives you a holistic view of your calorie intake & expenditure through seamless integration with your food log, workouts, and sleep.

RECOVERY, SLEEP & STRESS – ALL COVERED: Perform at your best every day by tracking sleep stages, stress, HRV, and more. With your daily recovery score and real-time insights, know when to rest or push. Other Gabit devices like the Smart Scale, CGM, and Blood Work help you track 150+ body markers for a deeper view of your health.

WOMEN'S HEALTH: Track your menstrual cycle, symptoms, mood, ovulation, and pregnancy with precision. Comprehensive predictions & logging to support your cycle - stay informed and manage your menstrual health effectively.

AI POWERED: PEP, VOICE BASED FOOD LOGGING: PEP is your AI-powered health coach that decodes your fitness, sleep, and stress metrics. It tracks changes and gives personalised, actionable tips to keep you on track. Also, with Voice-based food logging you just speak into your phone to log meals - making nutrition tracking quick, easy, and hassle-free.
